desc:
Want to play with just your friends? How about practice by yourself? You can play on your own, or with just friends in a VIP server! Note: Points cannot be earned in VIP servers.

Welcome to Dance Your Blox Off! Get ready to turn, jump and strut your way to victory in this virtual dance competition! From costume to choreography all the creative choices are up to you! Seven styles of dance all linked to your keyboard or on-screen touch buttons! 

This game was released on February 8th, 2017.

Note: This game contains flashing lights.

Awards: Fifth Annual Bloxy Awards: Best Art Direction in a Game
